title: The AI factory race that's reshaping every chip deal! #ai #futureofwork #nvidia
cleaned_content: This video discusses the intense global competition to build "AI factories," referring to massive data centers optimized for AI training and inference. The takeaway is that securing and scaling AI infrastructure is now a primary competitive differentiator for nations and corporations.
